verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents tracing of agent runs, with spans and tool calls you can inspect. It records application activity as spans and lets you browse traces and individual spans in the UI or CLI. The evidence does not show explicit parent/child span nesting or grouping traces into sessions or threads; the 'trace coding-agent sessions' CLI mention covers a different use case. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of nested span hierarchies, session/thread grouping of multi-turn agent runs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Inspect every agent trace and tool call, search across millions of logs, and track latency, cost, and quality in real time.
Browse traces and individual spans, in the UI or from the terminal
Tracing records what your application does as spans you can inspect in Braintrust.
Diagnose why one complex trace went wrong
